faq_heading: Little Mountain houses: your questions answered

faq.q: What did houses in Little Mountain sell for?
faq.a: 17 houses sold in Little Mountain between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,115,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Little Mountain?
faq.a: The median was 29 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.3% of the last list price (12% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Little Mountain sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 17 houses that sold in Little Mountain went for between $880,000 and $1,255,000, around a median of $1,115,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Little Mountain sell above asking price?
faq.a: 12% of the 17 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 98.3% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Little Mountain?
faq.a: The median year built was 1989 for the 17 houses sold in Little Mountain.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Little Mountain usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Little Mountain had 4 bedrooms, from the 17 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

What Little Mountain houses sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

17 houses sold in Little Mountain with a median price of $1,115,000 (the middle half sold between $880,000 and $1,255,000), taking a median of 29 days to sell at 98.3% of the last list price; 12% sold above list. They had a median $366 per square foot, a median year built of 1989 and a median lot of 10,086 square feet.
How Little Mountain compares with the rest of Chilliwack

The median house in Little Mountain sold for $1,115,000, 35% above the Chilliwack median of $825,000 across 294 sales. Little Mountain houses took a median 29 days to sell, against 26 days for Chilliwack as a whole.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a community is listed only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.
